class Solution:
    def calculate(self, s: str) -> int:
        v, n = 0, len(s)
        sign = '+'
        stk = []
        for i, c in enumerate(s):
            if c.isdigit():
                v = v * 10 + int(c)
            if i == n - 1 or c in '+-*/':
                match sign:
                    case '+':
                        stk.append(v)
                    case '-':
                        stk.append(-v)
                    case '*':
                        stk.append(stk.pop() * v)
                    case '/':
                        stk.append(int(stk.pop() / v))
                sign = c
                v = 0
        return sum(stk)
